headline: Can VR glasses save VR?
summary: Meta unveils new $1,299 VR Glasses, sparking debate over their impact. Despite the high price and mixed feelings about Meta, the technology is deemed revolutionary. These glasses are positioned as a potential game-changer for the future of virtual reality.

headline: Microsoft’s Office and Teams chief is leaving
summary: Ryan Roslansky, Microsoft's head of Office and Teams, is departing the company. His exit comes after nearly 18 years and recent promotions within Microsoft. This leadership change will trigger another major reshuffle at the tech giant.

headline: Inside Microsoft’s big Copilot rethink
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella unveiled a new vision for Copilot to enterprise customers. He pitched the AI assistant as the "OS for work" during an invite-only event. This marks a significant strategic rethink for Microsoft's Copilot initiative.

headline: NYC bans sketchy subscriptions with new "click-to-cancel" rule
summary: New York City becomes the first U.S. city to enforce a "click-to-cancel" rule for subscriptions. Businesses must now make it as easy to cancel a service as it is to sign up. Residents can submit complaints against companies making cancellation difficult.

headline: Ex-Star Wars Boss Kathleen Kennedy admits "relief" after leaving Lucasfilm
summary: Former Lucasfilm boss Kathleen Kennedy expressed "relief" after stepping down. Her 14-year tenure overseeing Star Wars was often tumultuous. Kennedy stated "These Jobs Are Not Easy" reflecting on the challenging role.

headline: "The Art of Metaphor: ReFantazio" book available for preorder
summary: The official art book for "Metaphor: ReFantazio" is now open for preorders. Priced at $50, the book offers a deep dive into the game's visuals. It is slated for release on March 9th of next year.

headline: 007 First Light's first DLC adds New Game Plus
summary: "007 First Light" has released its free "Extended Operations" DLC today. The DLC adds five new TacSim missions and introduces New Game Plus mode. New outfits and a long-awaited photo mode are also included.

headline: GTA 6 officially rated M for Mature by ESRB
summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially received an M for Mature rating from the ESRB. The rating confirms the inclusion of expected adult content, including nudity. This aligns with the series' reputation for mature themes and gameplay.

headline: UK-Iranian dual national arrested over RAF Fairford incident
summary: A 27-year-old UK-Iranian dual national has been arrested in London. Counter-terror police conducted the arrest in connection with an incident at RAF Fairford. Details of the specific incident remain under investigation.

headline: Hundreds of criminals begin early release from UK prisons
summary: Hundreds of prisoners in the UK are beginning early release under a new scheme. Around 4,500 inmates are projected to be released by June 2027. The initiative aims to alleviate severe overcrowding in the country's prisons.

headline: Netanyahu claims Flydubai flight attacker was "Islamist radical"
summary: Israeli PM Netanyahu claims the Flydubai flight attacker underwent "Islamist radical indoctrination". He asserted the pilot's clear intent was to "down the plane". The statement follows an incident involving a pilot attempting to take over the aircraft.

headline: Man City to argue sponsorship deals originated from Abu Dhabi government
summary: Manchester City will argue its sponsorship deals originated from the Abu Dhabi government. This defense is part of their appeal against the Premier League's financial verdict. The club aims to clarify the source of its funding to counter allegations.
